title: Kotiko backup (schema version 2)
description: The JSON backup of slice 12 section 2, written by the extension and by the server (GET /api/v1/export, mix kotiko.export). `words` are word records (word.schema.json), every one that isn't deleted. Version 1 is the shape before base languages, read as slice 12 section 2 says (its meanings were for English pages). A newer Kotiko reads every older version; an older one refuses a newer file. Never holds a key or a token.

settings.description: Optional. Non-secret settings (slice 39's list): enabled, pausedHosts, hiddenLangs, prefs, mixing, speech, seedSalt, lookup (provider, baseUrl, model, dataCollection; never a key), server (url; never the token), ui (uiLang, baseLangs).

stats.description: Optional. Slice 46's daily counters, when that slice ships.
